name: VerticalBarChart
intent: A complete vertical bar chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `VerticalBarGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a cohesive data visualization. `VerticalBarChart` itself is a thin composition/orchestration layer — it has no D3 usage and no runtime JS token resolver; layout math (D3 scales) lives in `VerticalBarGroup`, and all styling reads CSS custom properties directly via `var(--Token-Name)`.
